correctness.rationale: The 242 input facet list consists of 16 triangles on eight vertices. Independently generated all legal 2-2 moves, identified isomorphism via degree-class-restricted canonical relabeling, and exhausted the breadth-first closure: exactly six closed surface types. Directed counts 242:(1133 2,161 2,323-A 2,404 1); 323-A:(1133 2,242 2,323-B 2); 404:(242 4); 161:(1133 2,161 2,242 2,323-B 2); 1133:(1133 1,161 1,242 1,323-A 1,323-B 1); 323-B:(1133 2,161 2,323-A 2). The simple quotient has nine edges, diameter three, unique leaf 404. Full finite closure proof relies on canonical invariance and complete edge enumeration, not a numerical sample.
